university: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

programme.title: BEng in Computer Science (COMP)
programme.degree: BEng, 4 years; admission is to the department (CSE), with a free choice between BEng COMP and BEng AI by the end of year 1
programme.how_found: CSE department undergraduate pages; admissions facts from join.hkust.edu.hk (international qualifications route). DOMAIN: kb_top100_list.json gives official_domain 'ust.hk' but official_site 'https://hkust.edu.hk/'; every page used here is on hkust.edu.hk (cse.ust.hk redirects to cse.hkust.edu.hk). The checker's official-domain list for this case must include hkust.edu.hk, or every item fails 'official'.
programme.notes: Admissions page (script-rendered): https://join.hkust.edu.hk/our-programs/school-of-engineering/computer-science, twins /zh-hant/ and /zh-hans/. Program catalog: https://prog-crs.hkust.edu.hk/ugprog. Related: BSc in Computer Science (COSC), a double-major half.

english.quote: IELTS (International English Language Testing System) Academic Overall Band: 6.0
english.notes: University's English Language Admissions Requirement (PDF). No IELTS per-band minimum. TOEFL iBT: total 80 in one sitting for tests before 21 January 2026, 4.5 on the new scale from that date. Duolingo: overall 125 (from 1 July 2024). IB English, GCE English etc. also accepted.

gpa.notes: No published grade or GPA minimum for international qualification holders; the application asks for 'School reports from Grade 10 onwards' and predicted grades (IB). Selection is competitive; no threshold to record.

extra_quotes: Deadline for Priority Round Applications Description 25 Nov 2026
deadline.notes: International qualification holders, 2027 intake: system opens 2 Oct 2026; priority round deadline 25 Nov 2026; rolling basis from 26 Nov 2026; application closes 30 Jun 2027 (places may fill earlier; priority round recommended for scholarships). No time zone stated.

tuition.quote: Tuition Fee (Non-local Students) * HKD 260,000(~USD33,000) per academic year in 2027/28 academic year
tuition.notes: Non-local undergraduate tuition, 2027/28, per academic year. Accommodation ~HKD 21,000-51,000 per residential year (2026 figures; 2027/28 not announced).

value.name: University Admissions Scholarship for Other Qualifications

scholarship_exists.quote: Admissions scholarships are awarded to top students from all backgrounds based on academic merit and non-academic achievements.
extra_quotes: All applicants are considered for academic scholarships. No separate application is required for academic scholarships.
scholarship_exists.notes: Merit-based, competitive, automatic consideration; amounts are on the linked scheme page (not opened). Separate non-academic scholarships (BAAS) need their own application (priority deadline Nov 25, 2026).

scholarship_international.quote: Admissions scholarships are awarded to top students from all backgrounds based on academic merit and non-academic achievements.
scholarship_international.notes: 'from all backgrounds' plus a dedicated scheme for 'Other Qualifications' (non-HKDSE, i.e. international qualifications). No explicit nationality sentence quoted; any change in local/non-local status changes scholarships.
